t: This is the Black Friar, a pub on Queen Victoria Street in Blackfriars. The building went up around 1875 on the site of a medieval Dominican friary, which is where the name comes from. What you see today is largely the work of the architect Herbert Fuller-Clark, who remodelled it in the Arts and Crafts style from 1905, with decorative work by the sculptors Frederick Callcott and Henry Poole. It is Grade II star listed, and the Campaign for Real Ale gives its interior three stars, meaning outstanding national historic importance.
